# Skin claritySkin

Even tone starts with lighting and routine

If texture reads uneven, we suggest gentler cleansing and a consistent moisturizer — then re-check under the same light.

# HydrationSkin

Dehydration shows up as dull mid-face zones

Reports flag low-clarity regions and pair them with low-effort care steps, never a diagnosis.

# Color matchClothing

Clothes that flatter your undertone

From your scan we suggest a short palette — cool neutrals, warm earth, or soft contrast — so outfits support the face, not fight it.

# SilhouetteClothing

Neckline and structure for your proportions

Open necklines, clean shoulders, or softer collars — ranked by effort so style changes feel doable this week.
